articles.summary: The Vaca Muerta shale formation in Neuquén, Argentina, continues to unlock new opportunities while raising the bar for what the local energy industry needs. For Tenaris, the answer lies in staying close to its customers, combining experience across different markets, and translating that knowledge into products and services tailored to local operational needs.
articles.title: Tenaris shares its Vaca Muerta vision at the Shale in Argentina event in Houston
